overview.title: About PAH GMC Baramati
overview.affiliation: Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (MUHS), Nashik
overview.description: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Government Medical College, Baramati, is a premier medical institution located in Baramati, Maharashtra. Established in May 2019, it is affiliated with MUHS Nashik and recognized by the NMC, offering undergraduate and postgraduate medical courses with state-of-the-art campus and hostel facilities.

deanDesk.title: Dean's Desk
deanDesk.message: Welcome to Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Government Medical College & General Hospital, Baramati. As a distinguished professional in dermatology and medical administration, my vision is to lead this institution toward excellence in medical education, ethical clinical research, and compassionate healthcare delivery to the community. We strive to mold competent, skilled, and empathetic medical professionals.

rti.title: RTI Information & Officers
rti.description: Under Section 4(1)(b) of the Right to Information Act 2005, the institution maintains proactive transparency.
